column1: # gt6bridge recipe additions (applied to GT6 recipe maps)
# syntax: <map>
#   <map>     : GT6 recipe map field of gregapi.data.RM
#               Smelter
#               Canner
#               (report.txt lists every map name the pack has)
#   inputs    : item tokens joined with '+' -> ONE recipe with SEVERAL inputs (not alternatives);
#               each token may still expand to one recipe per matching stack
#   outputs   : item tokens joined with '+'; optional '@chance' per output
#   eut       : GT6 energy per tick (default 16)
#   duration  : ticks (default 16
#   optimize  : GT6's first addRecipe1 flag (default true)
# item tokens:
#   mod:name[:meta]        e.g. minecraft:iron_ingot  or  EnderIO:itemAlloy:6
#   ore:<OreDictName>      e.g. ore:ingotIron          (one recipe per matching stack)
#   gt:<prefix>:<material> e.g. gt:dust:Iron           (the GT6 item for that prefix+material)
# Note: for everything the material pass binds
# (Crusher/Mortar/Shredder/Anvil/...). Add rows here for the rest - alloys in the Mixer
# smelting chains
# examples (all disabled - remove the leading '# ' to enable):
